messages:
Maya Lin: Quick ask — for NovaHealth's QBR next Wed, can we run a 45m 'onboarding studio' (live demo + hands-on Q&A) for their infra/eng leads? Need facilitator and 2 possible times. cc @Luca Bianchi @Samira Patel
Luca Bianchi: Yep, I'm happy to facilitate the live demo. What TZ are they in?
Samira Patel: They're PST (San Francisco). Renewal check: account shows slower usage last month, worth surfacing a short migration checklist in the session.
Maya Lin: PST works. Thinking 3pm or 5pm PST — 3pm is better for their engineers, 5pm might catch execs. Which do you prefer, Luca?
Luca Bianchi: 3pm PST preferred for hands-on. 5pm ok if we make it more of a product overview and invite PMs.
Evan R.: +1 for 3pm. Also propose we record and drop a trimmed 10m highlight clip for their CSM. Saves follow-up.
Samira Patel: Good call. Can we also include a 10-min renewal health check at the top? 1 slide: usage, open tickets, roadmap ask. Keeps execs aligned.
Maya Lin: Agreed. Draft agenda (45m):
```
- 00:00-05:00: Quick account health (Samira)
- 05:00-25:00: Live onboarding studio (Luca) — demo + guided prompts
- 25:00-40:00: Hands-on Q&A / triage sample issues
- 40:00-45:00: Next steps & recording link + action items (Maya)
```
Maya Lin: Can someone confirm host (Zoom), calendar invite, and whether they want a dedicated test dataset?
onboard-bot: Suggested calendar blocks created: 2026-03-11 15:00 PST (45m) and 2026-03-11 17:00 PST (45m). Please react with :white_check_mark: to confirm preferred slot.
Luca Bianchi: Reacted :white_check_mark: to 15:00. I'll prepare a short notebook and 2 starter prompts.
Samira Patel: I'll prep the 1-slide health check and pull recent usage metrics. Also tagging @Evan R. for recording/edit notes.
Evan R.: Got it — will handle recording + extract highlights after session. Also can add closed-caption transcript.
Maya Lin: I'll send the invite to their eng lead + PM + CSM and request a short pre-read. Can we capture any specific migration questions we should prep for?
Samira Patel: Common asks: tokenization differences across engines, recommended batching configs, and cost-vs-latency tradeoffs.
Luca Bianchi: I'll include examples for batching + `max_tokens` tips.
Maya Lin: Perfect. I'll confirm final attendee list today and lock 15:00 PST. Thanks all :tada:
